breaking_news.headline: Yes, it's possible to save money while paying off credit card debt. Here's how

breaking_news.headline: AI tokens could become the kilowatt-hour of the AI age

breaking_news.headline: As many are priced out of buying, the renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever

breaking_news.headline: FIFA has a new plan to raise billions of dollars: Selling stakes in the World Cup

breaking_news.headline: More Americans are going bankrupt. What does that mean?

breaking_news.headline: A divided Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady despite high inflation
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged Wednesday.  Fed policymakers say they remain committed to curbing stubborn inflation.

breaking_news.headline: The renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever, as many are priced out of buying

breaking_news.headline: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents
breaking_news.summary: It marks a change of tone for his administration, which has taken a more hands-off approach to the technology.

breaking_news.headline: Pesticide-sprayed tomatoes suspected to have killed 15 elephants in Kenya
breaking_news.summary: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

breaking_news.headline: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
breaking_news.summary: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.

breaking_news.headline: Three children among eight dead in Russian strikes on Ukraine, officials say
breaking_news.summary: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

breaking_news.headline: Thousands evacuated in Crete as Europe battles wildfires

breaking_news.headline: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM

breaking_news.headline: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war

breaking_news.headline: The Chinese robot army transforming the UK's retail industry
